next_step.title: Next Step
next_step.description: Index of the next step after a correct answer; null on the last step and after a wrong answer.

matched_rules.title: Matched Rules
matched_rules.description: Names of the known mistakes that give this answer. For analytics and development; not for showing to a child.

unrecognized.title: Unrecognized
unrecognized.description: Wrong, and no known mistake explains it.

reteach_topic.description: Where to step back to, if anywhere.

Equation.title: Equation
Equation.description: `left = right`, as tokens, so a frontend can draw the box as a real box.

position.title: Position
position.description: Place in the topic's list of error patterns, from 0. With the topic id it identifies the pattern across re-imports.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Fixes the puzzle. Leave out for a random one.

distance.title: Distance
distance.description: 1 for a direct prerequisite, 2 for one of its own, etc.

required_by.title: Required By
required_by.description: Id of the topic that directly needs this one. For a direct prerequisite that is the topic asked about.

options.title: Options
options.description: The answer and three wrong answers, in an order that is fixed for the puzzle.

hint_tiers.title: Hint Tiers
hint_tiers.description: How many hint tiers can be asked for.

in_scope.title: In Scope
in_scope.description: True for mathematics topics for ages 7-12. False for topics that are only here because an in-scope topic needs them first.

assessment_prompt.title: Assessment Prompt
assessment_prompt.description: The assessment prompt with the child's name filled in, or worded to 'you' when no name is given.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of topics matching the filters, before paging.
